_about: Inference engines entail does not watch (field test, entail#38: WhisperX transcribes with CTranslate2 and MinerU runs its document model with llama.cpp, and the page only showed a side model's checks). When one of these modules finishes importing in a process with entail on, the launch records one unknown at engine:<module>.unwatched - what that engine computes is not among the results - once per process. Keys are the modules' import names, values what users call them.
